_comment: Who speaks Lani's Slovene (companion/README.md, Voice). A speaker: an ElevenLabs voice (eleven_v3), a local Gepard voice for when ElevenLabs can't, and a gender (the app's fallback voice and grammar). 'female' and 'male' are the narrators of every generic text; a villager speaks with their 'speaker' (companion/cultures/<culture>/villagers/*.json). To swap a voice, change its 'elevenlabs' id (the voice must be in the ElevenLabs account), then re-voice its clips: companion/bin/voice-build --run --revoice <speaker>. 'carrier': the speaker says a lone word inside a carrier sentence that is then cut out (the narrators, English library voices, say a lone Slovene word the English way; companion/README.md, Voice). 'alternatives' are the audition runners-up (library voices: add one to the account first). 'denoise': the voices whose ElevenLabs clips are filtered before they are stored (a voice that hisses).

denoise._comment: A voice that hisses → the filter its ElevenLabs clips go through before they are stored (companion/README.md, Voice): 'hiss' (true means this one), or 'hiss-strong' if 'hiss' leaves some. The key is a speaker below, or someone's own designed voice ('@janez': Stari Janez's, ElevenLabs GSjfM5vjA9qucp51dZnc, which hisses). The bridge filters new clips; the clips from before: companion/bin/voice-build --denoise --run. After a redesign, check whether the new voice still hisses. Since 2026-09-28 also the girl (Torri Miles), the young man, gruff, France's and Micka's own voices: their pauses at −38 to −55 dB, the others' −58 to −88; 'hiss' takes them to −74 to −96 dB.
